name: Assortment Planning core scenarios
description: Real Assortment Planning Q&A pairs grounded in the synthetic seed data (see data/generate_seed_data.py): a trend question (Down Parka), an anomaly question (Running Shoe at STORE-101), and a general performance question. NOT currently wired to a runnable eval CLI gate: `adk eval` (google-adk 2.5.0) doesn't support YAML Agent Config agents (confirmed 2026-07-26 against ADK source, see architecture spec section 8) -- these cases are content-ready but need either a different eval mechanism or an ADK fix before they run as a quality gate.

parts.text: How has the Down Parka been trending over the last two months?
